title: Dietitian Field Practicum at Gwangjin-gu Center for Children & Social Welfare Foodservice
titleEn: Dietitian Field Practicum at Gwangjin-gu Center for Children & Social Welfare Foodservice
organization: Gwangjin-gu Center for Children & Social Welfare Foodservice Management
summary: Conducted on-site sanitation supervision across community childcare centers, rapid ATP microbial swabbing, produced kitchen safety card news, and formulated specialized diets.

tasks: Conducted on-site hygiene audits using standardized inspection checklists in community kitchens.

Implemented color-coded waterproof indicator stickers for cutting boards to eliminate cross-contamination.
Received an 'A+' evaluation and commendation as an outstanding intern from the center director.
learnings: Established the professional philosophy of an empathetic hygiene consultant who collaborates with on-site staff to co-create sustainable sanitary standards.
